title: Test data behind the papers

asked.text: Group the papers in my library by what they were tested on: a benchmark other papers also use, or data the paper made for itself.

report:
Three of the eight papers were tested on data other papers also use; the other five built their own. RAGTruth is the one shared set for RAG hallucination itself: [Kovács & Recski 2025](owlit://library/arxiv-2502.17125) and [Sun et al. 2024](owlit://library/arxiv-2410.11414) both report on it. The open QA sets ([Asai et al. 2023](owlit://library/arxiv-2310.11511), [Saad-Falcon et al. 2023](owlit://library/arxiv-2311.09476)) test answering, not detection.

## Shared benchmarks

[Kovács & Recski 2025](owlit://library/arxiv-2502.17125) train and test on RAGTruth alone. [Sun et al. 2024](owlit://library/arxiv-2410.11414) use RAGTruth and Dolly. [Asai et al. 2023](owlit://library/arxiv-2310.11511) report on six QA and long-form tasks (PopQA, TriviaQA, PubHealth, ARC, ASQA, biographies); [Saad-Falcon et al. 2023](owlit://library/arxiv-2311.09476) on KILT and SuperGLUE.

## Data the paper made for itself

[Manakul et al. 2023](owlit://library/arxiv-2303.08896) generate GPT-3 passages about WikiBio people and label them by hand. [Es et al. 2023](owlit://library/arxiv-2309.15217) build WikiEval. [Mallen et al. 2022](owlit://library/arxiv-2212.10511) build PopQA, which Self-RAG later reuses. [Wu et al. 2024](owlit://library/arxiv-2404.10198) write about 1,200 questions in six domains and perturb the documents themselves.

## What it means for your related work

A comparison of the three families on the same answers has one ready ground, RAGTruth, and two of the papers already stand on it. SelfCheckGPT would have to be run on RAGTruth answers; nothing in the paper says it was.
